description: This file defines a PHP class 'TimeModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' which subscribes to module status change events within the OrangeHRM dashboard module. It handles changes in the 'time' module's status and updates related widget permissions accordingly.

classes.name: TimeModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens for module status change events within the OrangeHRM dashboard, specifically monitoring the 'time' module and updating widget permissions when its status changes.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the module status change event to the handler method 'onStatusChangeEvent'.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles the module status change event, checks if the previous module was 'time', and updates the dashboard widget permissions accordingly.
